text_blocks.snippet: Cinccino ex is a Colorless-type Stage 1 Pokémon ex card from the Chaos Rising (ME04) expansion in the Pokémon Trading Card Game.

list.snippet: Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Ability: Smooth Coat — Whenever damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.
Attack: Energized Slap [C] — This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.
Ultra Rare / Full Art (#105/086): Full-art variant.
Special Illustration Rare (#119/086): Alternative high-rarity art printing available on TCGplayer.com.
